verdict.rationale: Wise's API docs explicitly reference spend-controls (rules by MCC or transaction currency) and card-level spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe), which directly support granular per-card controls; however, these are API-level developer resources rather than confirmed self-service dashboard UI features for finance leads, and no evidence describes setting numeric spend limits per employee card. missing for 10: confirmation of a UI-based dashboard for finance-leads to set numeric spend limits per card, independent/hands-on verification of these controls in the Wise Business console, and evidence of per-employee limit granularity beyond category/MCC rules.
